title: selaginella radiata
intro: Selaginella radiata, commonly known as Spikemoss, is a type of evergreen plant that belongs to the Selaginellaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and improve respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of Spikemoss include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which can help to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of Spikemoss include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
